page.overview:
What is My Own Creation?

My Own Creation was a LEGO theme in the late 1990s and early 2000s, featuring sets designed by fans. All of these sets were also included under the Legends line. One of the creations, for example, was a blacksmith shop complete with a Blacksmith minifigure and his wife.
